prompt:
Architectural floor plan of one room, drawn straight from above as a clean top-down orthographic plan view in the style of a set designer's ground plan: white background, thick dark walls with gaps for doors and windows, door swings drawn as arcs, windows as thin double lines, and every piece of furniture as a simple outline from above, to scale. In the plan, its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall, as the establishing view names them. Draw only the doors, windows and openings the description names. Location: INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM. A bright, spacious, stylish contemporary downtown penthouse living room in cream, gold and soft grey. Back wall: wide windows with sheer white curtains letting in soft daylight from behind. A plush cream bouclé sofa stands in the middle of the room with its back to these windows, facing the camera, with silk cushions. In front of it is a round travertine coffee table holding flowers and a tablet stand on a pale rug. Right wall: an open doorway into the kitchen, framed in brushed brass, with a glimpse of white marble counters. Left wall: the opening to the entrance hallway, the way in, beside a low gold-legged console with a mirror. Front wall, behind the camera: a TV wall. Light comes from the window daylight and a modern brass floor lamp beside the sofa.

Avoid: people, text, labels, numbers, letters, dimensions, compass, logos, watermark, a door or window the description does not name.
